range_decision.evidence: A clear temporary offset appears in all three components (N, E, U) between indices 448 and 475: at index 448, N drops ~6 MAD, E jumps ~6 MAD, and U drops ~12 MAD; the offset persists through index 475, then reverses sharply at index 476 with N rising ~6 MAD, E falling ~6 MAD, and U rising ~12 MAD—returning to the pre-offset trend level. The shape is a sustained plateau across all axes, distinct from surrounding smooth motion or isolated spikes.
